briefs.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track every vaccinated person.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including the CDC, Mayo Clinic, and various fact-checking organizations, state that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. Experts explain that it is impossible to fit a microchip, power source, and transmission capabilities into the small gauge needle used for vaccinations. The microchip conspiracy theory gained traction from misinterpretations of comments made by Bill Gates about digital vaccine records and misrepresentations of RFID chips used on vaccine vials. Some claims also falsely linked magnetic effects on vaccinated arms to microchips.
